--adjudicate.help: Enable per-finding adjudicator: for each deterministic HIGH/CRITICAL finding, ask the LLM whether the matched content is a real threat or a literal-regex false positive. Demote-only (never promotes) — LLM errors leave findings at original severity. Uses SKILL_SCANNER_LLM_MODEL (or SKILL_SCANNER_ADJUDICATOR_LLM_MODEL to override).

--aidefense-api-key.help: AI Defense API key (or set AI_DEFENSE_API_KEY)

--aidefense-api-url.help: AI Defense API URL (optional, defaults to US region)

--all.help: Scan all skills, not just staged ones

--check.help: Fail if generated outputs differ from committed files

--compare.help: Run both with and without Meta-Analyzer and show comparison

--custom-rules.help: Path to directory containing custom YARA rules (.yara files)

--disable-rule.help: Disable a specific rule by name (can be used multiple times). Example: --disable-rule YARA_script_injection

--dry-run.help: Print the formula to stdout instead of writing the file.

--fail-on-findings.help: Exit with error if critical/high findings

--fail-on-severity.help: Exit with error if findings at or above LEVEL exist (critical, high, medium, low, info)

--format.help: Output format (default: summary). May be specified multiple times to produce several reports in one run, e.g. --format markdown --format sarif. Use 'sarif' for GitHub Code Scanning, 'html' for interactive report.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--input.help: Load existing policy YAML for editing

--lenient.help: Tolerate malformed YAML / missing fields: coerce bad fields, fill defaults, and continue instead of failing. Binary and non-UTF-8 files always fail.

--llm-consensus-runs.help: Run LLM analysis N times and keep only findings with majority agreement (reduces false positives, increases cost)

--llm-max-tokens.help: Maximum output tokens for LLM responses (default: 8192). Raise if scans produce truncated JSON.

--llm-provider.help: LLM provider shortcut or explicit OpenAI-compatible override

--max-skills.help: Max skills to scan from corpus (0=all)

--no-render-markdown.help: With --format markdown to terminal: print raw markdown instead of rendering (for pipe/copy).

--output-html.help: Write HTML report to this file

--output-json.help: Write JSON report to this file

--output-markdown.help: Write Markdown report to this file

--output-sarif.help: Write SARIF report to this file

--output-table.help: Write Table report to this file

--policies.help: Specific policy files (default: all in evals/policies/)

--policy.help: Scan policy: preset name (strict, balanced, permissive) or path to custom YAML

--recursive.help: Recursively search for skills (default: True; use --no-recursive to disable)

--render-markdown.help: With --format markdown: render markdown even when stdout is not detected as a TTY.

--rule-packs.help: Additional signature rule packs to enable (e.g. 'atr'). Use '--rule-packs list' to show available packs.

--rules-file.help: Path to YAML rules file or directory (default: built-in signatures)

--scan-all.help: Scan all skills, not just staged ones

--show-aitech.help: Show AITech taxonomy codes in detailed findings

--show-details.help: Show detailed per-skill analysis in compare mode

--skill-file.help: Custom metadata filename to use instead of SKILL.md (e.g. README.md)

--taxonomy.help: Path to custom taxonomy JSON/YAML (overrides SKILL_SCANNER_TAXONOMY_PATH)

--threat-mapping.help: Path to custom threat mapping JSON (overrides SKILL_SCANNER_THREAT_MAPPING_PATH)

--use-aidefense.help: Enable AI Defense analyzer (requires API key)

--use-meta.help: Use Meta-Analyzer to filter false positives and prioritize findings (requires --use-llm)

--use-osv.help: Enable OSV.dev dependency vulnerability scanning (no API key; requires network)

--verbose.help: Include per-finding policy fingerprints, co-occurrence metadata, and keep meta-analyzer false positives in output

--version.help: show program's version number and exit

--yara-mode.help: YARA detection mode: strict (max security, more FPs), balanced (default), permissive (fewer FPs, may miss threats)

configure-policy.help: Interactive TUI to build a custom scan policy

filenames.help: Changed files supplied by pre-commit (falls back to staged files when omitted)

generate-policy.help: Generate a default scan policy YAML

scan-repo.help: Clone and scan a GitHub repository for skills

not_attempted.raw: skill-scanner configure-policy -i policy.yaml -o policy.yaml   # Interactive TUI
